problems.name: Strongly Connected Steiner Subgraph
problems.definition: Given a digraph \(G=(V,E)\) and a set of terminals \(T=\{t_1, t_2, \ldots, t_k\}\), is there a set \(H\subseteq V\) of size \(\leq p\) such that \(G[H]\) has a \(t_i \leadsto t_j\) path for each \(1\leq i\neq j\leq k\)?

results.statement: No \((2-\epsilon)\)-approximation in \(f(k)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time (for any function \(f\)) under Gap-ETH

problems.name: Directed Odd Cycle Transversal
problems.definition: Given a digraph \(G=(V,E)\), is there a set \(H\subseteq V\) of size \(\leq k\) such that \(G[V\setminus H]\) has no (directed) odd cycles?

results.statement: There is a constant \(\epsilon>0\) such that there is no \((1+\epsilon)\)-approximation in \(f(k)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time (for any function \(f\)) under the Parameterized Inapproximability Hypothesis (PIH) and FPT \(\neq\) W[1]

problems.name: Directed Steiner Network
problems.definition: Given a digraph \(G=(V,E)\) and a set of terminal pairs \(T=\{(s_i, t_i)\ :\ i\in [k]\}\), is there a set \(H\subseteq V\) of size \(\leq p\) such that \(G[H]\) has an \(s_i \leadsto t_i\) path for each \(i\in [k]\)?

results.statement: No \(k^{1/4-o(1)}\)-approximation in \(f(k)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time (for any function \(f\)) under Gap-ETH

results.title: Bidirected graphs (Bi-DSN)
results.statement: When the input graph is bidirected, i.e., for every edge \(u\rightarrow v\) the reverse edge \(v\rightarrow u\) is also present and has the same weight, the problem is called Bi-DSN. There is a \(2\)-approximation in \(2^{k\log k}\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time. On the lower bound side, there is a constant \(\epsilon>0\) such that there is no \((1+\epsilon)\)-approximation in \(f(k)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time (for any function \(f\)) under Gap-ETH.

results.title: Bidirected graphs, planar solutions (\(\text{Bi-DSN}_{\text{Planar}}\))
results.statement: In bidirected graphs, the problem of finding an optimal planar solution is called \(\text{Bi-DSN}_{\text{Planar}}\). There is a \((1+\epsilon)\)-approximation in \(\max\{ 2^{k^{2^{O(1/\epsilon)}}}, n^{2^{O(1/\epsilon)}} \}\) time. On the lower bound side, a \((1+\epsilon)\)-approximation is not possible in \(f(\epsilon,k)\cdot n^{o(\sqrt{k})}\) time (for any function \(f\)) under ETH.

problems.name: Tree-cut width
problems.definition: Is the tree-cut width of a given undirected graph \(\leq w\)? See [W15] for a definition of tree-cut width.

results.statement: No lower bound is known. There is a (non-constructive) FPT algorithm for tree-cut width parameterized by \(w\).

problems.name: Steiner Orientation
problems.definition: Given a mixed graph \(G=(V,E)\) and a set of terminal pairs \(T=\{(s_i, t_i)\ :\ i\in [k]\}\), is there an orientation of the undirected edges of \(G\) such that the resulting graph has an \(s_i \leadsto t_i\) path for each \(i\in [k]\)?

results.statement: No \((19/20+\epsilon)\)-approximation (for any \(\epsilon>0\)) in \(f(k)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time (for any function \(f\)) under Gap-ETH, even if the input graph is planar

problems.name: \(k\)-Cut
problems.definition: Given an edge-weighted undirected graph \(G\) and an integer \(k\), can we remove a set of edges of weight \(\leq p\) so that \(G\) has at least \(k\) connected components?

results.statement: 1.81-approximation in \(2^{O(k^2)}\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time, and \((1+\epsilon)\)-approximation in \((k/\epsilon)^{O(k)}\cdot n^{k+O(1)}\) time for every \(\epsilon>0\)

problems.name: \(k\)-Median
problems.definition: Given a metric space \((V,d)\) with \(n\) points and clients at some of the points, open \(k\) facilities such that the sum of distances from the clients to their closest facilities is minimized.

results.statement: For every \(\epsilon>0\), a \((1+\frac{2}{e}+\epsilon)\)-approximation in \(f(k,\epsilon)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time
No \((1+\frac{2}{e}-\epsilon)\)-approximation (for any \(\epsilon>0\)) in \(f(k)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time (for any function \(f\)) under Gap-ETH

problems.name: \(k\)-Means
problems.definition: Given a metric space \((V,d)\) with \(n\) points and clients at some of the points, open \(k\) facilities such that the sum of squared distances from the clients to their closest facilities is minimized.

results.statement: For every \(\epsilon>0\), a \((1+\frac{8}{e}+\epsilon)\)-approximation in \(f(k,\epsilon)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time
No \((1+\frac{8}{e}-\epsilon)\)-approximation (for any \(\epsilon>0\)) in \(f(k)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time (for any function \(f\)) under Gap-ETH

problems.name: Directed Multicut with 4 pairs
problems.definition: Given a digraph \(G=(V,E)\) and a set of terminal pairs \(T=\{(s_i, t_i)\ :\ 1\leq i\leq 4\}\), is there a set \(H\subseteq V\) of size \(\leq p\) such that \(G[V\setminus H]\) has no \(s_i \leadsto t_i\) path for each \(1\leq i\leq 4\)?

results.statement: No \((59/58-\epsilon)\)-approximation (for any \(\epsilon>0\)) in \(f(p)\cdot n^{O(1)}\) time (for any function \(f\)) under Gap-ETH
